admission.justification: Listing and read tests pin the newest-first cap, task filter, nulls, refusals and exact live/archived targets; the single-request resolve test pins bounded resolution; the obligation spans the serving endpoint and the report routes in two files.

applicability: Every task page showing references or recorded role starts, on any master.
conditions: References resolve in one server request; null stays plain text; nested-only bare names stay text while pathed and top-folder bare names link per the Parent reference-format disposition.
Recorded starts render newest-first capped at twenty with an explorer link; report targets open the exact recorded report for live and archived starts with all refusals intact.
exclusions: Resolution performs no tree search; cost is bounded by reference count, not tree size.
Null report paths render no dead link.

evidence: listing tests + read tests (live/archived open, refusals incl. preserved partial-chain 409); pytest green

statement: A task page shows its references resolved by one request and its recorded role starts newest-first capped at twenty with an explorer link; report targets open the exact recorded report for live and archived starts; nested-only bare names stay text while pathed and top-folder bare names link per the Parent reference-format disposition.
